capabilities.description: Receives signed rating.set webhooks and triggers SubExtractor to extract and translate subtitles to French.

presentation.summary: Rating a profile item triggers automatic French subtitle extraction and translation via SubExtractor.
presentation.description_markdown: When a profile rates an item, silo's notification system delivers a signed `rating.set` webhook to this plugin. The plugin verifies the HMAC signature, then asks SubExtractor to download the video, extract and translate its subtitles to French, and upload them back to silo as subtitle-provider subtitles.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install the plugin, then configure the SubExtractor connection (URL, API key, and the shared webhook secret). Copy the webhook URL shown on the plugin's admin page into **Settings → Notifications → Webhooks** and enable Ratings.

global_config_schema.title: SubExtractor connection
global_config_schema.description: Connection settings for the SubExtractor instance that performs extraction and translation.

fields.label: SubExtractor URL
fields.description: Base URL of the SubExtractor instance (e.g. http://subextractor:8975). Plain HTTP is allowed only for private/local hosts.

fields.label: SubExtractor API Key
fields.description: The WEB_UI_API_KEY of the SubExtractor instance. Sent as a Bearer token to /api/silo/process.

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Same value as SubExtractor's SILO_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Used to verify the webhook HMAC when no matching id is present in webhook_secrets (acts as secret id "default").

fields.label: Additional Webhook Secrets
fields.description: Optional JSON object mapping secret id → secret for multiple silo webhook registrations, e.g. {"subex": "whsec_..."}. Entries take precedence over the default webhook_secret for matching ids.
